findings.title: `downsize` is defined twice, so the second definition silently replaces the first
findings.description: The diff adds `def self.downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts={})` directly after the existing `def self.downsize(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts={})`. In Ruby the later definition replaces the earlier one with no error, so the `max_width, max_height` version is unreachable. Any caller that still passes width and height as separate arguments now binds `dimensions` to the width and `opts` to the height. `opts[:allow_animation]` then raises on an Integer. The uploads controller's three-argument call (`"80%"` plus an options hash) works with the new definition. This review was done from the diff alone without tools, so I could not check other callers of `downsize`.

findings.title: `OptimizedImage.dimensions` was removed without a visible replacement
findings.description: The diff deletes `self.dimensions(width, height)`. Any caller outside the changed hunks would now raise `NoMethodError`. I could not search the codebase to confirm whether such callers exist, so this needs a check before merge.
